reasoning_trace: Traced hidden_tests from run_suite (:1080) back to parse_pytest (:546): the summary and the -rA outcome lines are read from the stdout of a process that imports agent-authored code (any conftest.py or ini file the agent adds at rootdir is not in grader_protected). Reproduced on this host with the grader's exact argv: a conftest pytest_unconfigure hook printed 'PASSED …' lines and '===== 2 passed in 0.01s =====' after two real failures and called os._exit(0); the grader's regex picked passed=2, rc=0. A root pyproject.toml with addopts='-p no:terminal' removed pytest's own output entirely, leaving bad empty, so all_pass is true. Dissent DISS-C-001 reaches the same conclusion by a different route (python_files/--ignore-glob overrides).
finding: Hidden-test results are forgeable by agent-authored code running inside the test process; hidden_tests, all_pass and verdict_accuracy trust unauthenticated stdout.
critique: The restore of grader_protected only covers files the task lists; the agent can add conftest.py / pyproject.toml / tox.ini / setup.cfg at rootdir and hook pytest_configure/pytest_unconfigure or atexit. The last-match summary parse and the absence of any cross-check between summary counts and outcome lines make the forgery trivial.
remediation: Before running the hidden suite, delete every conftest.py, pytest.ini, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, tox.ini (and *.pth) in the tree that is not in the fixture or the overlay; run with -c /dev/null (or --override-ini) so only grader-chosen options apply; write results with --junitxml to a grader-chosen file and cross-check against the summary (mismatch → parse_error); count only overlay-destination node ids and treat a missing hidden node as failed. Add a bats case with a forging conftest that must grade 0/N.

reasoning_trace: Every finding in grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-review.json and adversarial-audit.json carries anchor '<file>:<symbol>', anchor_type 'function' and integer anchor_line; none has file/path/line. envelope_texts therefore emits only the symbol anchor, which citations() cannot parse. Confirmed review Changes Required §3.
finding: Loa's own dissent envelope shape yields no citations; dissent-only catches earn zero recall.
remediation: When anchor matches ^(?P<file>[^:]+):(?P<sym>[A-Za-z_]\w*)$ and anchor_line is an int, emit f'{file}:{anchor_line}[-{anchor_line_end}]'; accept anchor_line as a line key; add a fixture copied from a real envelope to AG-8.

reasoning_trace: f comes from an 'ERROR <node>' line and path from 'PASSED <node>' lines in agent-influenced output (OUTCOME_RX :530). os.path.join discards tree for an absolute f; '..' is not rejected; copied symlinks (copy_tree :283/:294) are followed. 'ERROR /dev/zero' or a tree symlink tests/x.py -> /dev/zero makes .read() unbounded (memory exhaustion of the grader process, outside the container and the test timeout); a FIFO the agent created in its sandbox (host mode knows the absolute path) blocks the grader forever. def_line (:536) has the same open. Dissent DISS-001 (HIGH) and DISS-C-003 (MEDIUM) raised it independently; the audit had it as a low path-traversal before the DoS angle.
finding: Grader opens arbitrary host paths named in test output with unbounded reads; a graded agent can hang or OOM the grader.
remediation: Reject nodes whose path fails safe_rel() or is_within(tree); open with O_NOFOLLOW, stat for S_ISREG, cap the read (1 MiB); apply in both def_line and the coll_err expansion.

reasoning_trace: Symlinked into the stub PATH at :48; on any other machine the link dangles, bats execs 127 inside the stub, and AG-2 (:268) and AG-7 (:352) fail. The review rated this HIGH; the audit calibrates it MEDIUM (test evidence lost, no production path).
finding: Test depends on one operator's dotfiles path.
remediation: BATS_BIN="${LOA_TEST_BATS:-$(command -v bats || true)}" and skip when empty.

reasoning_trace: The container runs agent-authored test code. The argv has no --pids-limit, --memory, --cpus, --cap-drop ALL or --security-opt no-new-privileges; docker-stub.sh:56 lists --pids-limit/--memory/--cpus as flags the pipeline's own docker run uses. `timeout 120` sends TERM only (no -k) so a test trapping TERM runs on; the outer subprocess timeout (:518) then kills only the docker client, and with no --name there is no docker kill, so the container keeps the rw mount while the grader rmtree's the tree. Dissent DISS-C-006 confirms.
finding: Grading container has no process, memory or CPU limits, a TERM-only timeout and no cleanup path on client timeout.
remediation: Add --pids-limit 256 --memory 1g --memory-swap 1g --cpus 1 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges, use `timeout -k 10 120`, give the container a --name and docker kill it on TimeoutExpired.

reasoning_trace: os.walk(followlinks=False) still lists symlinks to directories in ds; os.chmod follows them. copy_tree preserves agent symlinks verbatim (:283, :294), so grading/final holds them and a re-grade (fresh_dir :1041) or a protected-dir restore (put_file :306) chmods the link target — any grader-owned directory. Dissent DISS-002 rated HIGH and DISS-C-005 MEDIUM; triaged MEDIUM: owner access survives, only grader-owned directories are affected, no data loss.
finding: remove_path chmods through agent-planted symlinks, violating the stated write boundary.
remediation: Skip os.path.islink(p) entries before chmod (or os.chmod(..., follow_symlinks=False) where supported).

code_snippet: full = ["env", "-i", "PATH=" + os.environ.get("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin"), "HOME=" + home, "LC_ALL=C", "TMPDIR=" + home, "PYTHONUSERBASE=" + site.getuserbase(), "timeout", str(TEST_TIMEOUT_S)] + argv
reasoning_trace: --executor host runs agent-authored test code (conftest.py, python_files modules, bats-loaded helpers) with the grader's uid, network and filesystem; env -i and a scratch HOME are the only isolation. Agent code can rewrite the suite's hidden/ tests or MANIFEST.sha256 after freeze_check already ran (:1270), poisoning every later grade. The mode is documented (header :77-81) but nothing warns at runtime. Dissent DISS-C-002 rated HIGH; triaged MEDIUM: opt-in, documented, container is the default.
finding: Host executor runs untrusted code unsandboxed with no runtime acknowledgement and no post-run freeze re-check.
remediation: Refuse --executor host for run-directory grading unless an explicit --allow-host flag is given (print a warning); re-run freeze.sh --check after the test runs in host mode and exit 2 on drift; keep host mode for self-check of trusted fixtures.

reasoning_trace: gate_verdict (:764) and review_md_verdict (:782) guard with isfile only; combined_findings (:877) adds not islink. The three inputs are agent-writable sandbox files: a symlink to /dev/zero yields one unbounded line (memory), a symlink to a FIFO blocks the grader, any readable host file is parsed. Separately, the FIX1/FIX2 agent can rewrite the reviewer's trailer in the sandbox and set its own verdict_accuracy. Dissent DISS-C-004.
finding: Verdict readers follow symlinks and read unbounded; verdicts come from agent-editable sandbox files.
remediation: Reject symlinks and non-regular files, cap bytes read; derive verdicts from harness-owned copies under eval/ (or a harness-recorded hash taken at gate time).

reasoning_trace: The hidden overlay lands before regression_command runs on base and final; a regression command sweeping the overlay directory counts hidden cases, which fail at base by design, so --self-check base fails a correct task.
finding: Regression suite runs after the hidden overlay.
remediation: Run regression_command on copies taken before the overlay, or restore only grader_protected for that run.

reasoning_trace: argparse last-wins: a caller's --no-secrets '' after the wrapper's value disables secrets_clean (seed_tasks.py:503-504) silently; and when no-secrets.sh is absent, rc 127 is read as a secret hit. Same at seed-refactor-tasks.sh:66.
finding: The no-secrets scan can be switched off from the wrapper's argv and misreports an absent scanner as a secret.
remediation: Reject a caller-supplied --no-secrets in the wrapper; check the scanner exists in the missing-tool loop; treat rc 127 as exit 2.

reasoning_trace: Host-mode allowed roots whitelist ~/.aws, ~/.claude.json and ~/.codex, so a Read of the caller's credentials is reported clean; the scan is substring based and sidestepped by hid""den, ~/… paths, relative traversal or a script the agent writes. The header calls the scan a lower bound, but grade.json exposes only contaminated: null. Dissent DISS-C-007.
finding: Credential directories are whitelisted and the scan's lower-bound nature is not visible in grade.json.
remediation: Add scan_coverage: 'lower_bound' to grade.json; flag ~/.aws and ~/.claude.json reads as a credential_path pattern; expand ~ and $HOME before matching.

rubric_notes: Security 2: hidden-test results are forgeable by the graded agent, test output can steer the grader into unbounded reads, and the container has no resource limits; the path trust boundary (safe_rel/safe_path, argv-only subprocess) is otherwise well built. Architecture 3: a 1130-line heredoc and an under-specified PR scope. Code quality 3: parse/accuracy edge cases. DevOps 2: interpreter floor and operator-specific test paths.
